title: Explore Granada from the inside.
text: Very highly recommended! Rubén, our guide, was incredibly friendly and knowledgeable. He helped us immerse ourselves in the local culture while exploring the different neighborhoods of Granada.
author: Inspire49867432348

title: Great e-bike tour of the city
text: We were greeted by Fanette and swiftly went through the bikes and we were off!! We rode out to the back of Granada with far reaching views of the city, Fanette has great knowledge of the history of the city and was very engaging throughout our ride, the whole experience was chilled with plenty of information about the history of Granada. Great way to see the city and learn its history
author: jeffhR3667SI

title: Friendly and helpful
text: Our group enjoyed the tour around Granada, Fanette (guild) was very friendly and accommodating, would definitely recommend her.
author: kellymP8084AW

title: Delicious bike tour through old Granada
text:
What a great tour. Enjoyed cycling through the old districts of Granada with a beautiful view of the Alhambra. 

Ruth, our guide, was fantastic!! What knowledge this woman had. She could show well, showed beautiful (and somewhat quieter) places.

The tapas were Spanish and at the end of the tour we got a tip where we could eat deliciously "Arabian".
author: Xandra19a

title: Biking Grenada with Carmen
text: Carmen was great!  She did a good job of making sure everyone got to the same places together. The conversation at the tapas places was enlightening. Best of all, my kids (18 and 19) loved it!
author: M5302FKjimr

title: ABSOLUTELY GORGEOUS
text: Loved Kaell he was incredible!!! Had such a great tour 🫶🏼 if you’re scared to do something different do this, it’s really fun and the fear lasts about 2 mins and then you’re off!
author: sophiesX3666TB

title: E-bike and Tapas tour of Granada
text: Carmen was an excellent guide. We really enjoyed our afternoon doing the e-bikes and tapas tour. She was very knowledgeable about the city and took us to various stunning view points as well as a couple of bars that were off the beaten tourist path. We would highly recommended this tour.
author: H7201TTlibbyw

title: Segway
text: Great day out on hills of Granada on a Segway with our guide Fares. He was very patient and funny and wouldn’t highly recommend. Thanks Fares.
author: matt_d

title: Best way to hit all the highlights of Granda by e-bike!
text: Fares was an exceptional tour guide showing us the best spots in Albacin and Sacramonte by e-bike. Very knowledgeable and friendly and the e-bikes were in fantastic shape. I would do it all over again!
author: Hope M

title: Electric bikes in Granada with Simon
text: Simon was a quality guide - lots of information, great fun and nothing was too much trouble. Good quality bikes - perfect for all the hills. Excellent communication from the team.
author: 888craigs
